I have identified and saved a gap synthesis titled "Lack of unified evaluation metrics and scenario diversity across driving policy studies" (synthesis ID: d65811b7-9f3f-5544-8cde-9e84ee080ec7). 

This synthesis highlights a gap in the evidence regarding the generalization of learned driving policies to new environments due to differences in evaluation scenarios and metrics used across studies. Some studies use specific scenarios with set parameters, while others provide diverse datasets but lack standardized evaluation metrics, limiting direct comparison and generalization assessments.
